data_objects.name: debate_team_records
data_objects.meaning: Spreadsheet-derived records for debate teams associated with a James Logan event, including wins, team naming, school affiliation, and standardization fields.
data_objects.notes: The physical CSV header is not the semantic header: the first data row supplies labels for most columns, and two separator columns have no visible content.

variables.name: JAMES LOGAN
variables.meaning: Column labeled as Wins in the embedded first row; subsequent team rows use it for a win total.

variables.name: Unnamed: 1
variables.meaning: Column labeled as Name in the embedded first row; it contains paired participant names for a team.

variables.name: Unnamed: 2
variables.meaning: Column labeled as Code in the embedded first row; it contains a school-and-team code.

variables.name: Unnamed: 3
variables.meaning: Column labeled as School in the embedded first row; it contains the team's school name.

variables.name: Unnamed: 4
variables.meaning: Unlabeled separator column with no stated semantic role.

variables.name: Unnamed: 5
variables.meaning: Unlabeled separator column with no stated semantic role.

variables.name: Unnamed: 6
variables.meaning: Column labeled STANDARD TEAM NAME in the embedded first row; it contains a normalized team label.

variables.name: Unnamed: 7
variables.meaning: Column labeled NUM ROUNDS in the embedded first row; it represents a number of debate rounds.

variables.name: Unnamed: 8
variables.meaning: Column labeled WEIGHTING in the embedded first row; the definition and scope of the numeric weighting are not stated.

structure.description: After the embedded label row, each populated record represents one debate team; participant names, the team code, school, and standard team name describe that team.
The first data row acts as a secondary header for the spreadsheet-derived columns rather than as a team record.

uncertainties: The event title does not identify a date, competition division, or season.
The scope of NUM ROUNDS and WEIGHTING is unclear because the spreadsheet-derived layout does not repeat those values across team rows.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the labels, values, and layout visible in train.csv.
